subject: Succession plan + approval to reassign IC3 SWE through internal lateral transfer
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: IC3 SWE vacancy — proposal to use lateral transfer

Hi Jonas,

Quick heads-up: Sam Patel (IC3 SWE on Data Platform) officially resigned effective 10/31. Team owners and I met yesterday and we put together a short succession plan attached that outlines two options: 1) external hire (standard backfill) or 2) internal lateral transfer (reuse existing IC3 headcount and move Rohan Mehta from Backend).

Summary:
- Impact: Product roadmap needs an owner for indexing infra — 2 quarters of risk if we wait for external.
- Cost: Lateral transfer keeps comp band mostly flat; re-level/promotion would add delta (see comp-band-comparison).
- Timeline: Internal transfer can be in-place in 2–3 weeks; external hire ~10–12 weeks.

Can you confirm you’re comfortable with us pursuing the internal transfer route so we can ask People/Recruiting to draft the internal offer? I’ve CC'd Lauren for People ops perspective. Attachment: succession-plan-swe-ic3.pdf, comp-band-comparison-ic2-ic3.xlsx

Thanks — Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: IC3 SWE vacancy — proposal to use lateral transfer

Laura — thanks for the context and the plan. I skimmed the attachments; doing an internal lateral sounds like the fastest path to keep velocity. Two asks before I give final go:

1) Can People confirm there’s no headcount policy blocker to reassign Rohan (or similar) and whether this requires a promotion conversation?
2) If we do proceed, I want the offer terms and comp delta (if any) spelled out so I can sign off.

CC'ing Neha to confirm the headcount/approval flow and Lauren for the People ops checklist.

If People approves, I'll OK the transfer and ask Eng to schedule a 1:1 with Rohan this week.

— Jonas

Subject: Re: IC3 SWE vacancy — proposal to use lateral transfer

Thanks for looping me in. People ops perspective:

- Policy: We can repurpose an existing IC3 headcount for a lateral internal move without opening a new req. No org-level approval required for lateral reassignments between teams if band stays the same.
- Re-levels: If you want to re-level Rohan to IC3+ or IC4, that triggers compensation sign-off and Manager + Recruiting + Finance approvals; timeline ~2 weeks for approvals and updated offer paperwork.
- Recommendation: Proceed with lateral transfer on current band and use a short-term performance plan if there are promotion considerations later.

Attaching a short checklist (linked in the succession plan doc) and referencing HR ticket HR-2241 for the formal workflow.

Lauren
People Partner
--
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 06 Nov 2025 15:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: IC3 SWE vacancy — proposal to use lateral transfer (headcount/finance note)

Jonas — thanks. Confirming the following from People & Finance side:

- Headcount: We have one approved IC3 SWE headcount in Eng Core that can be repurposed. No additional headcount request required.
- Compensation delta: If we keep the same band and title (IC3), the delta is $0. If you ask for a spot re-level to IC3+, estimate +7–10% on current OTE. Finance will need a brief memo to approve any raise beyond band mid-cycle.
- Offer mechanics: Recruiting will generate an internal offer letter (internal-transfer template). We will route comp approvals through the normal workflow (Recruiting -> People -> Finance).

I attached a quick comp-band-impact spreadsheet for reference (comp-band-comparison-ic2-ic3.xlsx). Please advise if you want Finance to pre-approve a small re-level buffer — that speeds things up.

Neha Kapoor
Head of People Ops (Talent & Compensation)
--
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 Nov 2025 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: IC3 SWE vacancy — proposal to use lateral transfer

I support the internal transfer. Rohan has the technical skills and familiarity with our stack — switching him in will minimize ramp. A couple of operational notes:

- Please schedule a 1:1 between Rohan and the new team lead this week so we can surface any blocker.
- If there's any comp delta request from Rohan, I ask we keep it within the 7% buffer Neha mentioned. Finance approval will be necessary for anything larger.
- If Rohan declines, we should be ready to kick off an external search; loop in Greenfield as the contingency.

Markus
Eng Director, Core Systems
--
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 14:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Final — approve reuse of IC3 headcount for lateral transfer (Rohan Mehta)

Thanks all for the input. Based on People & Finance confirmation and Markus's support, I approve pursuing the internal lateral transfer of Rohan Mehta into the vacated IC3 SWE role. Action items: 

- Recruiting (internal): prepare internal offer using the internal-transfer template and current IC3 band (no automatic re-level). Neha: please kick off comp routing in parallel and flag if Rohan requests >7% uplift.
- Laura: schedule the 1:1 with Rohan and hiring team this week.
- Markus: please prepare a short ramp plan for the next 8 weeks.

If Rohan declines within 72 hours, Recruiting should immediately open an external req and engage Greenfield Recruiting (Sara — included here as FYI).

Final attachments: succession-plan-swe-ic3.pdf

Jonas Weber
Staff PM, Core Platform
Redwood Inference
